HEADQUARTERS
CRIME BRANCH
NOVEMBER 5, 40

2623/39 B'well
6 case reopened 1

On 10-10-40 detectives attached to C.B.H.Q. C.1.
whilst rendering assistance to the Japanese Gendarmerie
conducted a raid at House No.4 Lane 429 Amiral Bayle.
wherein it was believed members of an anti-Japanese
terrorist organization were residing.

No arrests were made however, but a search of
the room resulted in the seizure of five mauser pistols,
three Smith & Wesson Revolvers and 1330 rounds of ammu-
nition.

Amongst these firearms one, a mauser auto 7.63,
No.691746 was upon examination found to have been used
in this crime.

This same pistol was also used in the murder
of Supt. Tan Shao Liang. B'Well F.I.R.2556/40.

Arrests which were made during the course of
enquiries were closely interrogated, but none could be
connected with the Medium Club murder.

It is believed that the firearms belonged to a
section of a Pro Chungking Terrorist Organization known
as the "Blue Shirts", which section was under the com-
mand of one named Wong Tsung (王成 ) who has not yet
been arrested.

Please see C.1.Misc.197/40.

D. S.

1940年10月10日，隶属于总部刑事科 C.1 组的侦探在协助日本宪兵队时，对贝勒路（Amiral Bayle Road）429弄4号房屋进行了突击搜查，据信反日恐怖组织成员居住于此。

虽未实施逮捕，但对房间的搜查导致缴获五支毛瑟手枪、三支史密斯威森（Smith & Wesson）左轮手枪和1330发子弹。

在这些枪支中，经检查发现其中一支编号为691746的7.63毫米毛瑟自动手枪曾被用于此犯罪案件。

同一支手枪也被用于谭绍良巡官谋杀案。B'Well F.I.R.2556/40。

在调查过程中实施的逮捕均经过严密审讯，但无人能与“Medium Club”（注：此处指前文提到的印度俱乐部或相关场所，原文混用）谋杀案联系起来。

据信这些枪支属于一个亲重庆恐怖组织“蓝衣社”的一个分支，该分支由一名名为王成（Wong Tsung）的人指挥，此人尚未被捕。

请参阅 C.1.Misc.197/40。

D. S.

In response to a telephone call from
D.I. Tabrum, D.S.I. MacAdie proceeded to Bubbling
Well Station at 5.50 p.m. with the object of
interrogating one TU CHIUN MOU, whose wedding
ceremony at the Medium Club, 674 Weihaiwei Road
was the target for an attack by a group of armed
men who at 4.30 p.m. October 22nd opened fire on
the guests killing and wounding a number, afterwards
making good their escape.
TU CHIUN MOU, the bridegroom was not hurt,
and was taken to Bubbling Well Station, where he
admitted being the acting chief of the Propaganda
Department of the "Great People Society," 22
Columbia Road and claimed that he suspected one
ZUNG ZUNG SHING (鄭誠興), a relative of his,
who is a man of the loafer type to be responsible
for the shooting owing to a private grudge.
However, as it was suspected that the attack had
other motives, he was brought to Special Branch
Headquarters, where it was expected that he could
be persuaded to release some information that would
serve in elucidating the case. Questioned with the
assistance of D.S.I. Liac Chung Chien, TU could not
be persuaded to divulge any more than what he had
stated in Bubbling Well Station, i.e. he is the
acting Chief of the Propaganda Department of the
"Great People Society" at 22 Columbia Road, which
has a total membership of 30,000 persons, of whom,

应 Tabrum 警督的电话要求，MacAdie 高级警督于下午5时50分前往静安寺捕房，目的是审讯一名名为 TU CHIUN MOU（杜君謀）的男子，其于10月22日下午4时30分在威海卫路674号 Medium Club（注：原文如此，实为印度俱乐部）举行的婚礼仪式成为一伙武装人员袭击的目标，这伙人向宾客开火，造成多人死伤，随后成功逃脱。
新郎 TU CHIUN MOU（杜君謀）未受伤，被带至静安寺捕房，他承认自己是哥伦比亚路22号“大同社”（Great People Society）宣传部的代理主任，并声称他怀疑其亲戚 ZUNG ZUNG SHING（鄭誠興），一个游手好闲之徒，因私人恩怨应对枪击事件负责。
然而，由于怀疑袭击另有动机，他被带至特务科总部，期望能说服他提供一些有助于阐明案件的信息。在 Liao Chung Chien（廖仲坚，音译）高级警督的协助下进行讯问，Du（杜）未能被说服透露比他在静安寺捕房所述更多的内容，即他是哥伦比亚路22号“大同社”宣传部的代理主任，该社总成员为30,000人，其中，

some 5,000 are in Shanghai. He also repeated his
statement regarding his suspicion of his relative
ZUNG ZUNG SHING. However, when it was pointed out
to him that ZUNG, who according to his (TU's)
statement, was a man without means and would not
be able to employ a gang in possession of several
pistols and that it was hardly credible that ZUNG
would resort to what amounted to a massacre of TU's
friends and relatives to satisfy a private grudge,
however bitter he felt, TU admitted that he himself
was at a loss to understand the case. Seeing that
further persuasion would prove fruitless he was
requested to make a voluntary statement as to his
antecedents, which he agreed. (A copy of his
statement is attached hereto). Subsequently, TU
was sent back to Bubbling Well Station at 8.50 p.m.
October 22.
It is of interest to note that the gangsters
responsible carried out the shooting in a wanton and
reckless manner, indicating that no particular persons
had been selected as the victims of attack. However,
they did direct their fire to one particular side
and this fact is of the utmost importance in seeking
a motive for the affair. As is the custom in China
the guests at a wedding party are divided into two
sides, male and female, and generally guests of each
sex stand on the side indicated although naturally
some encroaching is done for the purpose of

值得注意的是，肇事的暴徒以肆意和鲁莽的方式实施枪击，表明并未选定特定人员作为袭击受害者。然而，他们确实将火力集中在某一侧，这一事实对于寻找事件动机至关重要。按照中国的习俗，婚礼派对的宾客分为男女两侧，通常每种性别的宾客站在指定的一侧，尽管自然会有些越界以便

conversation etc.    Both TU CHIUN MOU and his wife
admitted that all the firing was done in the direction
of the female side. As most of the children present
are on this side, the attack is made to appear even
more brutal.
    In this light, the allegation that the
embittered relative ZUNG ZUNG SHING was responsible
can be discounted and his presence in the early
stage of the ceremony when he attempted to extort
money is likely to/be merely a coincidence or possibly
a blind.    Again, assassination was not the motive
as had the attack been the work of Chungking elements,
and the bridegroom the intended victim he could have
been shot much more conveniently and effectively,
entering or leaving the reception, while it must
be noted that a far more important political person
namely, the Chief of the "Great People Society,"
LI Yoeh-quin (李王花) was present. The attack
being the work of other pro-Japanese cliques for
motives of jealousy or friction may also be ruled
out for the same causes.
    There seems to be only one reason why the
fire was directed away from the male guests, that is
the possibility that the attackers were of the same
political sympathies and did not wish to shoot their
own men. If this is so then the only explanation
is that the attack was staged to embarrass the
Settlement Authorities. It took place in the

在此情况下，可以排除心怀怨恨的亲戚 ZUNG ZUNG SHING（鄭誠興）负责的指控，他在仪式早期试图勒索钱财时的出现可能仅仅是巧合，或者 possibly a blind（注：原文不清，意为障眼法或掩护）。再者，暗杀并非动机，因为如果袭击是重庆方面所为，且新郎是预定受害者，那么在他进入或离开招待会时将其射杀会方便和有效得多，同时必须注意到，一位更重要的政治人物，即“大同社”社长 LI Yoeh-quin（李王花，音译，可能为李业勤或其他，依指令保留拼音或音译）也在场。出于嫉妒或摩擦，其他亲日派系所为的袭击也可因同样原因予以排除。

Settlement, was directed against pro-Japanese elements
and followed closely on the events in the Western
District. It may serve as a lever to protest
against the inefficiency of the Shanghai Municipal
Police, to divert attention from the attacks on the
Shanghai Municipal Police in the Western District
or to attempt to show that the killings in the
Western District are the work of anti-Japanese

they attacked pro-Japanese officials in the
Settlement.
It will be recalled that a number of the
members of the WANG CHING WEI armed gang, known as
the Chung Kuo Kuomintang Anti-Comintern and National
Salvation Army, were formerly members of another
group named "Iron and Blood Corps." They were
responsible for numerous armed outrages in the
Western District, O.C.L., in the early part of the
current year. They were responsible for several
cases of indiscriminate shootings in Jessfield Area,
including the firing on a police van on February 22,
1939 in Jessfield Road which resulted in the death
of C.D.C.162, LIU ZANG HUNG. After joining the
pro-WANG CHING WEI faction they took part in other
indiscriminate shooting affrays including the one
in front of the Chinese American Daily News,
No.162 Avenue Edward VII, on July 22, 1939.

回想起来，汪精卫武装帮派的一些成员，即所谓的中国国民党反共救国军，曾是另一个名为“铁血团”的组织的成员。他们在今年年初负责了西区 O.C.L.（注：可能指 Outer Circular Limit 或特定区域缩写）的多起武装暴行。他们负责了杰斯菲尔德（Jessfield，即兆丰公园/中山公园附近）地区的几起 indiscriminate shootings（无差别射击）案件，包括1939年2月22日在杰斯菲尔德路向一辆警车开火，导致 C.D.C.162，LIU ZANG HUNG（刘藏洪，音译）死亡。在加入亲汪精卫派系后，他们参与了其他无差别射击冲突，包括1939年7月22日在爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII，即延安东路）162号《中美日报》门前的冲突。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.

The following is the statement of Tu Chuin Kou (杜君謀) aged 27
D.S.I. MacAdie
native of Quinsan taken by me D.S.I. Liao Chung Chien
at on the 22nd October, and interpreted by 1939.

My name is Tu Chuin Kou (杜君謀), aged 27,
native of Quinsan, residing at No.32 Yu Koh Tsung (愚谷邨),
Yu Yuen Road, C.C.L. At the age of seventeen, I graduated
from the Quinsan Middle School, Quinsan, and went to join
the Yangchow Flour Mill, Yangchow, as a clerk. At the age
of 20 I was transferred to Shanghai and worked in the same
capacity with the Shanghai Office of the flour mill situated
at corner of Changsha and Avenue Roads. The flour mill
closed when the Sino-Japanese hostilities broke out in
Shanghai in August 1937. In September 1938, I was appoint-
ed a clerk of the Shanghai Branch of the Great People
Society, at No.22 Columbia Road, through the recommendation
of Kao Ling (高明), the brother of Kao Soh (高朔),
the late Chief of the Great People Society. In July 1939,
the chief of the propaganda department of the society, one
named Li resigned and I was nominated as the acting chief
of the said department. I have some ten office colleagues
but none of whom has any private grudge against me. As to
my friends and relatives, only one Zung Zung Shing (鄭誠興),
my brother-in-law, is not on good terms with me, he being a
man without means. On the morning of October 22, he came
to my house and demanded a sum of money. He was given $5
by my uncle and left expressing much dissatisfaction with
the amount he was given.

My father died when I was seven years old. As
my family was in possession of some 100 mow of land in
Quinsan I was able to complete my middle school education.

以下是 Tu Chuin Kou (杜君謀)，27岁，
昆山籍，由我 D.S.I. Liao Chung Chien（廖仲坚，音译）于1939年10月22日在______录取，并由______翻译的陈述。

我叫 Tu Chuin Kou (杜君謀)，27岁，昆山籍，居住在中央捕房辖区愚园路愚谷邨32号。十七岁时，我从昆山县立中学毕业，前往扬州加入扬州面粉厂担任职员。20岁时，我被调往上海，在位于长沙路和爱文义路（Avenue Road，即北京西路）转角的面粉厂上海办事处担任同等职务。1937年8月上海中日敌对行动爆发时，面粉厂关闭。1938年9月，通过已故“大同社”社长高朔（Kao Soh）的兄弟高明（Kao Ling）的推荐，我被任命为哥伦比亚路22号“大同社”上海分社的职员。1939年7月，该社宣传部主任李某辞职，我被提名为该部代理主任。我有大约十位办公室同事，但其中没有人对我有私人恩怨。至于我的朋友和亲戚，只有我的姐夫 Zung Zung Shing (鄭誠興) 与我不和，他是一个没有财力的人。10月22日上午，他来到我家索要一笔钱。我叔叔给了他5美元，他离开时对给他的金额表示非常不满。

我七岁时父亲去世。由于我家在昆山拥有约100亩土地，我得以完成中学教育。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.

The following is the statement of....................................................................................................
native of............................................................taken by me............................................................
at....................................................on the........................................and interpreted by....................................

- 2 -

My father-in-law, Chen Yu Tsi (陳雨濟), was formerly an
accountant of the Ah Silk Factory in Soochow. He has been
unemployed since the outbreak of current hostilities and is
at present residing in a dried goods shop in Yang Hong Ko,
Nantao, which is owned by one of his relatives. My wife,
Chen Seu Kwen (陳守坤) has no employment and is not
interested in politics.

During my wedding ceremony at 5.30 p.m. on
October 22, Li Yoeh-qgin, Chief of the Shanghai Branch of
the Great People Society, and several other senior members
of the organization were present but none of them were
wounded during the shooting as the armed men directed their
fire on the female guests.
